LEGAL // TERMS & CONDITIONS

TERMS & POLICY.

These terms govern creative project engagements, multimedia commissions, and usage conditions when collaborating with EZ Studio.

Last Updated: September 2026 • Version 1.0 (Placeholder)
Service Guidelines Notice: This page serves as a structured placeholder template for EZ Studio's business terms, project milestone policies, and service contracts. You can easily edit or replace any text block below.
01

Agreement & Acceptance of Terms

By commissioning creative work, approving an instant quotation, or entering into a creative agreement with EZ Studio, you agree to comply with and be bound by the terms, conditions, and operational policies detailed herein.

Any specialized or project-specific contract signed between EZ Studio and the client shall supersede these general terms in the event of any conflict.

02

Project Scopes & Instant Quotations

All estimates generated through our online quotation system represent non-binding preliminary price estimations based on standard parameters:

  • Quotations Validity: Custom quotations are generally valid for 30 calendar days from the date of issue unless specified otherwise.
  • Scope Clarity: Detailed asset resolutions, delivery formats (e.g. 4K video, vector logos, raw 3D assets), and turnaround dates are finalized in the formal agreement before project kickoff.
  • Out-of-Scope Requests: Additional feature requests, extra visual effect shots, or major conceptual shifts beyond the agreed brief will be quoted as separate milestone items.
03

Revision Rounds & Approvals

To ensure high artistic quality and timely production delivery, projects operate under iterative review cycles:

  • Standard creative deliverables typically include up to 2 rounds of revisions during draft milestones.
  • Client feedback should be consolidated and provided within reasonable review timeframes to maintain scheduled delivery milestones.
  • Final approval of master files indicates project sign-off and authorizes final delivery packaging.

Quality Guarantee: EZ Studio is dedicated to ensuring visual excellence and brand integrity across every motion graphic, video edit, and graphic design artifact.

04

Intellectual Property & Portfolio Rights

Upon receipt of final payment in full:

  • Client Ownership: The client receives the agreed commercial usage rights to the final rendered deliverables as defined in the project scope.
  • Working Files: Proprietary project source files (such as raw After Effects comp structures, 3D project hierarchies, and raw brush setups) remain the intellectual property of EZ Studio unless explicitly purchased as an asset deliverable.
  • Portfolio Presentation: EZ Studio reserves the right to showcase the completed work in promotional reels, website portfolios, social media showcases, and artistic case studies.
05

Payment Terms & Milestones

Standard project payments follow milestone structures (such as a 50% commencement deposit and 50% upon final delivery approval). Invoices are payable via bank transfer or approved digital payment methods within the designated payment schedule.

06

Cancellation & Postponement Policy

Should a project be cancelled or placed on indefinite hold by the client after kickoff, compensation will be calculated pro-rata based on completed work hours and milestones achieved up to that date.

07

Questions & Custom Inquiries

Have questions regarding our creative terms, special licensing needs, or specific collaboration arrangements? Let's discuss your project requirements:
